spans.s: कैरव (I) m. 1. A gambler, a cheat, a rogue; 2. an enemy.
कैरव (II) n. The white lotus which blossoms at moon-rise, चंद्रो विकासयति कैरवचक्रवालम् Bhartr.ii.73.
कैरव-बंधु m. an epithet of the moon.
कैरविणी f. 1. A creeper bearing white lotuses; 2. a pond abounding in white lotuses; 3. an assemblage of white lotuses.
